lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly visible high-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-rectangular grid posterior to the gill slits, with density increasing toward the anterior head region and clusters forming parallel horizontal rows along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical pale bands intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity blobs, creating a lattice-like structure where spots serve as anchor points at the intersection nodes, primarily visible in the mid-lateral section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A pronounced longitudinal ridge is visible on the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast luminance gradient with highlights on the upper margin and deep shadow on the lower margin, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced caustic network patterns resulting from surface light refraction are overlaid across the mid-section, creating transient high-luminance lines that intersect with the permanent biological spot pattern.
